title: Raja Ganesha captures effective authority in Bengal
detail: Amid Ilyas Shahi weakness, Raja Ganesha took control of the Bengal Sultanate's political center and began a short dynastic transition.

title: House of Ganesha period interrupts earlier dynastic continuity
detail: Rule associated with Raja Ganesha and his successors created an interregnum between Ilyas Shahi phases in Bengal's sultanate history.

title: Dynastic legitimacy in Bengal becomes more visibly negotiated
detail: The episode demonstrated how military force, court alliances, and conversion politics could reset succession and authority in late medieval Bengal.
